quote.text: Epictetus being asked how a man should give pain to his enemy answered, By preparing himself to live the best life that he can.
quote.author: Epictetus
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Strive to model a life of virtue and resilience for your children; by focusing on your own growth, you instill in them the power of self-improvement rather than reacting to external adversities.
    • Embrace challenges as opportunities to build character; when you prepare yourself to live your best life, you teach your children that true strength lies in cultivating inner wisdom and balance.
  • Leadership
    • A leader’s influence is amplified by the quality of their own character; by dedicating yourself to personal excellence, you set a powerful example and inspire others to overcome opposition through integrity.
    • Transform obstacles into stepping stones; prioritizing self-development in leadership not only disarms the negativity of adversaries but also guides your team towards a shared vision of excellence and self-mastery.
  • Product Management
    • Focus on constant improvement and innovation in your role, much like preparing to live your best life; this inner drive positions you to tackle challenges and to outshine competitors by delivering value.
    • Accept that external pressures—from competitors or market shifts—are best countered by refining your strategies and processes; embodying a commitment to excellence encourages a healthy, product-driven evolution.
